title: Easier Gaps And Webs
description: This datapack adds easier recipe for Golden Apple and Cobweb
body:
# Rebalanced Apples and Cobwebs

This lightweight datapack modifies the crafting recipe for Golden Apples and adds a new recipe for Cobwebs. It is perfect for multiplayer servers or SMPs where you want to balance survival pacing or make utility items accessible. Once installed, these changes are instantly active in survival mode.

🎯 **Purpose & Appeal**

In modern Minecraft multiplayer, traditional Golden Apples demand a large gold investment that slows down early-game exploration. Additionally, Cobwebs are frequently used for fast tactical defense or traps, but they are uncraftable in vanilla Minecraft.

By installing this datapack, you can restore fast-paced survival combat, easily obtain decorative blocks, and keep your gameplay smooth without tedious resource grinding.

✨ **Features**

* **Cheaper Golden Apple:** Modifies the crafting recipe to require only 4 Gold Ingots instead of 8.
* **Craftable Cobweb:** Adds a completely new crafting grid recipe using 5 Strings in an "X" shape.
* **Clean & Lightweight:** No lag, no custom commands, and zero impact on server performance.
